blocks.en: Next, R3 advertises to R1: “I’m R3, and A is infinity away from me.” R1 accepts (per Rule 2), and now R1 also has a cost of infinity. (Note: This advertisement looks just like poison, though the infinity originated from counting to infinity instead of detecting a failure.)
blocks.en_html: Next, R3 advertises to R1: “I’m R3, and A is infinity away from me.” R1 accepts (per Rule 2), and now R1 also has a cost of infinity. (Note: This advertisement looks just like poison, though the infinity originated from counting to infinity instead of detecting a failure.)
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，R3 向 R1 宣告："我是 R3，A 离我无穷远(infinity)。"R1 接受（规则 2），现在 R1 也有了无穷大的成本。（注：这个宣告看起来就像毒化(poison)，尽管这里的无穷大源于计数到无穷大(count-to-infinity)而不是检测到故障。）

blocks.en: Finally, R1 advertises to R2: “I’m R1, and A is infinity away from me.” R2 accepts (per Rule 2), and now all the routers have a cost of infinity.
blocks.en_html: Finally, R1 advertises to R2: “I’m R1, and A is infinity away from me.” R2 accepts (per Rule 2), and now all the routers have a cost of infinity.
blocks.zh_html: 最后，R1 向 R2 宣告："我是 R1，A 离我无穷远(infinity)。"R2 接受（规则 2），现在所有路由器都有了无穷大的成本。

blocks.en: We’ve reached steady-state again! Any future advertisements would all be advertising infinite cost, and they won’t change the tables. Eventually, the infinite-cost entries would all expire. Or, if another route to A appears, it would replace the infinite-cost entry.
blocks.en_html: We’ve reached steady-state again! Any future advertisements would all be advertising infinite cost, and they won’t change the tables. Eventually, the infinite-cost entries would all expire. Or, if another route to A appears, it would replace the infinite-cost entry.
blocks.zh_html: 我们又达到了稳态(steady state)！未来任何宣告都将宣告无穷大(infinity)成本，它们不会改变转发表(forwarding tables)。最终，这些无穷大成本的条目都会过期。或者，如果出现了到 A 的另一条路由，它会替换无穷大成本的条目。

blocks.en: Let’s review our protocol so far.
blocks.en_html: Let’s review our protocol so far.
blocks.zh_html: 让我们回顾一下目前的协议。

blocks.en: For each destination:
blocks.en_html: For each destination:
blocks.zh_html: 对于每个目的地(destination)：

blocks.en: If you hear an advertisement for that destination, update the table and reset the TTL if: The destination isn’t in the table. The advertised cost, plus the link cost to the neighbor, is better than the best-known cost. The advertisement is from the current next-hop. Includes poison advertisements.
blocks.en_html:
If you hear an advertisement for that destination, update the table and reset the TTL if:
  • The destination isn’t in the table.
  • The advertised cost, plus the link cost to the neighbor, is better than the best-known cost.
  • The advertisement is from the current next-hop. Includes poison advertisements.
blocks.zh_html:
如果你听到该目的地的宣告(advertisement)，在以下情况下更新转发表(forwarding table)并重置 TTL：
  • 表中没有该目的地。
  • 被宣告的成本加上到达邻居的链路成本，优于最佳已知成本。
  • 宣告来自当前的下一跳(next-hop)。包括毒化宣告(poison advertisements)。

blocks.en: Advertise to all your neighbors when the table updates, and periodically (advertisement interval). But don’t advertise back to the next-hop. …Or, advertise poison back to the next-hop. Any cost greater than or equal to 16 is advertised as infinity.
blocks.en_html:
Advertise to all your neighbors when the table updates, and periodically (advertisement interval).
  • But don’t advertise back to the next-hop.
  • …Or, advertise poison back to the next-hop.
  • Any cost greater than or equal to 16 is advertised as infinity.
blocks.zh_html:
当转发表更新时以及周期性（通告间隔(advertisement interval)）地，向你所有的邻居发送宣告。
  • 但不要宣告回给下一跳(next-hop)。
  • ……或者，向下一跳宣告毒化(poison)。
  • 任何大于或等于 16 的成本宣告为无穷大(infinity)。

blocks.en: If a table entry expires, make the entry poison and advertise it.
blocks.en_html: If a table entry expires, make the entry poison and advertise it.
blocks.zh_html: 如果表条目过期，将该条目设为毒化(poison)并宣告它。

blocks.en: Eventful Updates
blocks.en_html: Eventful Updates
blocks.zh_html: 事件驱动的更新(Eventful Updates)

blocks.en: There are three occasions where a router might want to send advertisements:
blocks.en_html: There are three occasions where a router might want to send advertisements:
blocks.zh_html: 路由器可能想要发送宣告的情况有三种：

blocks.en: Send advertisements when the table changes. These are called triggered updates. The table might change when we accept a new advertisement, or when a new link is added (e.g. new static route), or when a link goes down (e.g. route gets poisoned).
blocks.en_html: Send advertisements when the table changes. These are called triggered updates. The table might change when we accept a new advertisement, or when a new link is added (e.g. new static route), or when a link goes down (e.g. route gets poisoned).
blocks.zh_html: 当转发表(forwarding table)发生变化时发送宣告。这称为触发更新(triggered updates)。表可能在我们接受新宣告时发生变化，或在添加新链路时（例如新的静态路由），或在链路发生故障时（例如路由被毒化(poisoned)）。

blocks.en: Send advertisements periodically, once every advertisement interval.
blocks.en_html: Send advertisements periodically, once every advertisement interval.
blocks.zh_html: 定期发送宣告，每过一个通告间隔(advertisement interval)。

blocks.en: Send advertisements when a table entry expires (and gets replaced by poison).
blocks.en_html: Send advertisements when a table entry expires (and gets replaced by poison).
blocks.zh_html: 当表条目过期时（并被毒化(poison)替换）发送宣告。

blocks.en: Note that triggered updates are an optimization. Instead of advertising every time the table changes, we could just wait for the next advertisement interval to advertise the changes. This protocol would still be correct. However, triggered updates, in addition to the periodic updates, help our protocol converge on correct routes faster, because we propagate new information the instant we learn about it.
blocks.en_html: Note that triggered updates are an optimization. Instead of advertising every time the table changes, we could just wait for the next advertisement interval to advertise the changes. This protocol would still be correct. However, triggered updates, in addition to the periodic updates, help our protocol converge on correct routes faster, because we propagate new information the instant we learn about it.
blocks.zh_html: 注意，触发更新(triggered updates)是一种优化。我们不必在每次表变化时都宣告，完全可以等待下一个通告间隔(advertisement interval)来宣告变化。这个协议仍然是正确的。然而，在周期性更新之外增加触发更新，有助于我们的协议更快地收敛(converge)到正确路由，因为我们在了解到新信息的瞬间就将其传播出去。
